examples.en: Lava is extremely hot, so you should never touch it without fire resistance.
examples.ja: 溶岩はものすごく熱いから、耐火の効果なしでは絶対に触ってはいけないよ。

examples.en: The Nether is one of the hottest places in the game, full of lava and fire.

examples.en: Mining in the Nether is definitely hotter than exploring caves in the Overworld.

examples.en: This lava pool is getting hotter as we approach it from the obsidian platform.
